scope: Post-decision continuous XY diagnosis only. No classifier, new hint, normalization, threshold search or model replacement.
limitations: Exact XY accuracy applies only to the existing visible manual points in pitch_003.
Canonical reliability labels target original Full, not RTMPose.
Native coordinates on occluded points are model estimates, not observed truth.
Existing human-initialized CSRT ROI is a prerequisite.

diagnostic_audit.interpretation: Read-only arithmetic and equality replay of sealed outputs. Native coordinates on nonvisible human references are estimates, not new truth. No threshold optimization or new adoption decision.

outside_original_major_hold.criterion: existing original_major_hold is false; nonseed visible paired coordinates only; no new cutoff

tests.note: Tests rerun existing MediaPipe E2E; diagnostic itself makes no RTMPose inference or calibration.
